title: More Save Slots
description: A mod that aims to add more hotbar save slots!
body: More Saved Hotbars is a client-side Fabric mod that expands Minecraft’s Saved Hotbars tab with extra save slots and built-in row actions for quickly loading or saving hotbars. It keeps normal item interaction intact while making creative inventory organization faster, cleaner, and much more practical for builders, testers, and command users.
